Bug_Title: Classes should not access their own subclasses during class initialization
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs because the Parent class references a static method of its subclass Child during class initialization. This creates a fragile dependency on the order of class initialization, leading to incorrect behavior or even potential deadlocks.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls Parent.showBug() which indirectly triggers the initialization of Parent's static members, including the buggy line where Parent references Child during its own initialization. This creates a fragile dependency that results in the output being 0 instead of 42, triggering a failure in the test case.
